name: panopticon-skills
description: Claude Code plugin for Panopticon — a live dashboard of coding agents working through OpenSpec changes.

plugins.name: panopticon
plugins.description: Report OpenSpec progress to Panopticon: registers the `panopticon mcp` bridge, nudges the agent to call report_progress whenever a change's tasks.md is edited, shows each session's activity on the dashboard through hooks, lets you answer questions and permission prompts from the dashboard while you're away, and adds a reporting skill plus a /panopticon:setup check.
